title: Text-to-Speech Engine - public implementations survey
definition: Converts written text into spoken audio.
description:
Text-to-Speech Engine is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Converts written text into spoken audio. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Text-to-Speech Engine. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Text-to-Speech Engine. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Text-to-Speech Engine capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.
